description:
COACTUPC's cross-cutting ordering case: SIX edits fail in one pass and exactly ONE message reaches the screen. It is the case this folder's other nineteen have to be consistent with, because it pins the three rules that decide what any COACTUPC re-entry may claim - first-message-wins, the pessimistic-first state machine, and what 1205-COMPARE-OLD-NEW is as distinct from 9700-CHECK-CHANGE-IN-REC. THE PATH. This is the literal next turn of case04: what case04 returns in expectedResponse.navigation is, field for field, the sixteen CARDDEMO-COMMAREA fields declared in screenRequest.commarea here, CDEMO-PGM-CONTEXT is the 1 that app/cpy/COCOM01Y.cpy:31 names CDEMO-PGM-REENTER, and ACUP-CHANGE-ACTION arrives as the 'S' the 88 at app/cbl/COACTUPC.cbl:660 names ACUP-SHOW-DETAILS. EIBCALEN is 1033 - CARDDEMO-COMMAREA's 160 bytes plus the 873-byte WS-THIS-PROGCOMMAREA that COMMON-RETURN :1010-1013 packs behind it - so the left disjunct of the commarea gate at :880 is false, and CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM is spaces rather than COMEN01C so the right disjunct at :881-882 is false too: :888-892 restores both halves from DFHCOMMAREA and INITIALIZE never runs. EIBAID is DFHENTER, which YYYY-STORE-PFKEY :898-899 resolves to CCARD-AID-ENTER and the validity gate at :906-912 accepts, so the PFK-INVALID remap at :914-916 does not fire. The order-sensitive EVALUATE TRUE at :921 then falls to WHEN OTHER at :996 - :927 CCARD-AID-PFK03 is false, :964-965 needs ACUP-DETAILS-NOT-FETCHED and CDEMO-PGM-ENTER and has neither, :966-967 needs CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM = COMEN01C, :979-980 need 'C' or 'L'/'F' - and that arm performs 1000-PROCESS-INPUTS, then 2000-DECIDE-ACTION, then 3000-SEND-MAP, and leaves by the forward-only GO TO COMMON-RETURN at :1003. RULE ONE - FIRST-MESSAGE-WINS, AND THIS CASE IS ITS PROOF. WS-RETURN-MSG is PIC X(75) at :479 and carries 88 WS-RETURN-MSG-OFF VALUE SPACES at :480; 0000-MAIN arms it at :876 with SET WS-RETURN-MSG-OFF TO TRUE. Every single message assignment in this program - and every one in app/cpy/CSUTLDPY.cpy, which COACTUPC copies at :166 - is wrapped in IF WS-RETURN-MSG-OFF and takes the form STRING FUNCTION TRIM(WS-EDIT-VARIABLE-NAME) <suffix> DELIMITED BY SIZE INTO WS-RETURN-MSG. The first write clears the condition, so every later write is skipped, and the only place that ever re-arms it is the body 2000-DECIDE-ACTION shares between WHEN ACUP-DETAILS-NOT-FETCHED :2568 and WHEN CCARD-AID-PFK12 :2572, at :2574 - a body this path does not reach. SIX EDITS FAIL HERE and expectedMessages carries ONE entry, never six, never a concatenation. THE ARBITER IS SOURCE ORDER over the label sites between :1472 and :1657: Account Status :1472, Open Date :1478, Credit Limit :1484, Expiry Date :1490, Cash Credit Limit :1496, Reissue Date :1503, Current Balance :1509, Current Cycle Credit Limit :1515, Current Cycle Debit Limit :1522, SSN :1529, Date of Birth :1533, FICO Score :1545, First Name :1560, Middle Name :1568, Last Name :1576, Address Line 1 :1584, State :1592, Zip :1605, then - and this is reproduced rather than tidied (practice B5) - a COMMENTED-OUT 'Address Line 2' label at :1614 which assigns nothing and is left exactly as a comment, followed by the live City :1615, Country :1623, Phone Number 1 :1632, Phone Number 2 :1640, EFT Account Id :1648 and Primary Card Holder :1657. That is TWENTY-FIVE label sites of which TWENTY-FOUR are live. A twenty-fifth live label does exist but not in this block: 1265-EDIT-US-SSN OVERWRITES WS-EDIT-VARIABLE-NAME three times of its own accord - 'SSN: First 3 chars' :2439, 'SSN 4th & 5th chars' :2469, 'SSN Last 4 chars' :2481 - so the 'SSN' text moved at :1529 can never reach a message, and the message this case keeps names the sub-part instead. THE SIX FAILURES, spread deliberately across the whole order so the suppression is visible rather than incidental. Position 1, Account Status: the operator retyped it in LOWER CASE as 'y'. 1220-EDIT-YESNO :1856-1892 finds it neither LOW-VALUES nor SPACES nor ZEROS, then tests 88 FLG-YES-NO-ISVALID VALUES 'Y', 'N' at :78 - which is CASE-SENSITIVE - so it takes the ELSE at :1880, SETs INPUT-ERROR and FLG-YES-NO-NOT-OK, and writes 'Account Status must be Y or N.' Position 10, SSN: ACTSSN1I is '9X0', so 1245-EDIT-NUM-REQD :2137-2152 finds it not numeric and would write 'SSN: First 3 chars must be all numeric.' Position 12, FICO Score: the operator touched NOTHING - the fetched value is 274 - and 1275-EDIT-FICO-SCORE :2514-2529 tests 88 FICO-RANGE-IS-VALID VALUES 300 THROUGH 850 at :848-849 against ACUP-NEW-CUST-FICO-SCORE, the 9(03) REDEFINES at :846-847, so it would write 'FICO Score: should be between 300 and 850'. Position 22, Phone Number 2: again untouched - area code 373 - and EDIT-AREA-CODE :2296-2312 finds it absent from 88 VALID-GENERAL-PURP-CODE at app/cpy/CSLKPCDY.cpy:521, which lists 490 codes including the 908 of Phone Number 1 but not 373, so it would write 'Phone Number 2: Not valid North America general purpose area code'. Position 24, Primary Card Holder: the operator typed 'X', so 1220-EDIT-YESNO would write 'Primary Card Holder must be Y or N.' And after all twenty-four, the cross-field edit at :1665-1669: State 'NC' passed 1225-EDIT-ALPHA-REQD and 1270-EDIT-US-STATE-CD, Zip '12546' passed 1245-EDIT-NUM-REQD, so both flags are ISVALID and 1280-EDIT-US-STATE-ZIP-CD runs - it STRINGs the state and ACUP-NEW-CUST-ADDR-ZIP(1:2) into 'NC12' at :2537-2540 and finds it absent from 88 VALID-US-STATE-ZIP-CD2-COMBO at CSLKPCDY.cpy:1073, which carries NC27 and NC28 and no other NC prefix, so it SETs BOTH FLG-STATE-NOT-OK and FLG-ZIPCODE-NOT-OK and would write the one message in the program built from a bare literal rather than a variable name, 'Invalid zip code for state'. FIVE of those six texts are never written. ERRMSGO carries the first, from position 1, right-padded from WS-RETURN-MSG's PIC X(75) into the symbolic map's PIC X(78), and expectedMessages carries that same 78-byte image on the SCREEN_ERRMSG_78 channel because :2981 MOVE WS-RETURN-MSG TO ERRMSGO is literally where the program puts it. THREE OF THE SIX FAILURES ARE IN THE FETCHED DATA, not in what was typed - FICO 274, area code 373 and the NC/12546 pair are all exactly what acctdata.txt and custdata.txt hold - so account 00000000001 cannot be saved from this screen no matter what the operator does. That is inherited legacy behaviour and it is preserved rather than corrected (practice B5). RULE TWO - THE PESSIMISTIC-FIRST STATE MACHINE. 1200-EDIT-MAP-INPUTS :1429-1676 runs in exactly this order: SET INPUT-OK :1431; IF ACUP-DETAILS-NOT-FETCHED :1433 - false here, so the search-key branch at :1435-1446 and its GO TO are skipped; SET FOUND-ACCOUNT-DATA :1452, SET FOUND-ACCT-IN-MASTER :1453, SET FLG-ACCTFILTER-ISVALID :1454, SET FOUND-CUST-IN-MASTER :1456, SET FLG-CUSTFILTER-ISVALID :1457; PERFORM 1205-COMPARE-OLD-NEW THRU its EXIT :1460-1461; the short-circuit at :1463-1468, IF NO-CHANGES-FOUND OR ACUP-CHANGES-OK-NOT-CONFIRMED OR ACUP-CHANGES-OKAYED-AND-DONE then MOVE LOW-VALUES TO WS-NON-KEY-FLAGS and GO TO the exit - not taken here; then SET ACUP-CHANGES-NOT-OK TO TRUE at :1470, BEFORE A SINGLE FIELD EDIT HAS RUN; then the twenty-four edits; then the cross-field edit; and only at :1671-1675, IF INPUT-ERROR CONTINUE ELSE SET ACUP-CHANGES-OK-NOT-CONFIRMED TO TRUE. The state is therefore 'E' by default and is promoted to 'N' only by a clean pass. INPUT-ERROR is set, so it stays 'E' - the ACUP-CHANGES-NOT-OK of the 88 at :663, which the vocabulary at :656-668 distinguishes from ACUP-DETAILS-NOT-FETCHED (LOW-VALUES or SPACES), ACUP-SHOW-DETAILS 'S', ACUP-CHANGES-OK-NOT-CONFIRMED 'N', ACUP-CHANGES-OKAYED-AND-DONE 'C', ACUP-CHANGES-OKAYED-LOCK-ERROR 'L' and ACUP-CHANGES-OKAYED-BUT-FAILED 'F', with ACUP-CHANGES-MADE spanning all five of 'E','N','C','L','F' and ACUP-CHANGES-FAILED spanning 'L' and 'F'. 'E' IS ASSERTED THREE WAYS RATHER THAN NAMED DIRECTLY, because the compared navigation image is the shared 160-byte CARDDEMO-COMMAREA and ACUP-CHANGE-ACTION lives in the program's own extension behind it: (1) 3200-SETUP-SCREEN-VARS' EVALUATE at :2710-2724 reaches WHEN ACUP-CHANGES-MADE :2718 and so performs 3203-SHOW-UPDATED-VALUES, which repaints from ACUP-NEW-* - the screen shows the lower-case 'y', the '9X0' and the 'X' the operator typed, which no other arm can produce, since :2715 ACUP-SHOW-DETAILS would repaint from ACUP-OLD-* and :2711-2712 would blank the lot; (2) 3250-SETUP-INFOMSG's ordered EVALUATE at :2957-2977 falls past CDEMO-PGM-ENTER, ACUP-DETAILS-NOT-FETCHED and ACUP-SHOW-DETAILS to WHEN ACUP-CHANGES-NOT-OK :2964, whose SET PROMPT-FOR-CHANGES puts the 88 literal at :470-471 - 'Update account details presented above.', WITH ITS TRAILING PERIOD, thirty-nine characters in a PIC X(40) - into INFOMSGO PIC X(45) at :2979, right-space-padded to 45; (3) 3390-SETUP-INFOMSG-ATTRS :3573-3576 finds ACUP-CHANGES-MADE true and ACUP-CHANGES-OKAYED-AND-DONE false and so reveals the cancel legend, which is why FKEY12H carries DFHBMASB here and does not in case01 through case04. 2000-DECIDE-ACTION confirms the state survives: its EVALUATE at :2563 passes ACUP-DETAILS-NOT-FETCHED and CCARD-AID-PFK12 and ACUP-SHOW-DETAILS and lands on WHEN ACUP-CHANGES-NOT-OK :2596-2597, which is CONTINUE - so 9000-READ-ACCT is not performed, 9600-WRITE-PROCESSING is not performed, no file verb runs and the commarea leaves exactly as it arrived. RULE THREE - 1205-COMPARE-OLD-NEW IS NOT 9700-CHECK-CHANGE-IN-REC, and conflating them is the easiest way to author a wrong COACTUPC expectation. 1205 :1681-1779, which is what runs here, compares the screen's NEW values against the OLD copy the screen was painted from, to decide whether the user changed anything. 9700-CHECK-CHANGE-IN-REC :4109-4193, which case19 owns, compares a FRESHLY RE-READ record against that same OLD copy, to detect a concurrent update by another user: different fields, different comparison forms, different purpose, and reached only from 9600-WRITE-PROCESSING, which this path never enters. 1205 opens SET NO-CHANGES-FOUND TO TRUE :1682 and is two AND-chains, each of which fails to SET CHANGE-HAS-OCCURRED TO TRUE and GO TO 1205-COMPARE-OLD-NEW-EXIT. THE ACCOUNT CHAIN :1684-1700 compares ACUP-NEW-ACCT-ID-X raw; ACUP-NEW-ACTIVE-STATUS under FUNCTION UPPER-CASE ONLY, WITH NO TRIM :1685-1688; then the five monetary fields as their RAW PIC X(12) VIEWS - ACUP-NEW-CURR-BAL = ACUP-OLD-CURR-BAL and its four siblings at :1689-1691 and :1695-1696 - and NOT as the -N numeric REDEFINES at :764-795; the three dates as whole eight-byte compact spans :1692-1694; and finally ACUP-NEW-GROUP-ID under FUNCTION UPPER-CASE(FUNCTION TRIM(...)) :1697-1700. TEN OF THOSE ELEVEN COMPARISONS ARE EQUAL HERE, and the second one is the surprise: the lower-case 'y' that FAILED the case-sensitive 1220 edit is INVISIBLE to 1205, because UPPER-CASE('y') is UPPER-CASE('Y'). The five monetary comparisons are equal because the operator returned the +ZZZ,ZZZ,ZZZ.99 masks 3202 painted, TEST-NUMVAL-C accepts each of them at :1078, :1092, :1106, :1120 and :1134, and the COMPUTE that follows re-derives the identical zoned image through the -N view. THE CHAIN NEVERTHELESS FAILS, at its ELEVENTH and last comparison, and for a reason no operator caused: ACCT-GROUP-ID is ten SPACES in acctdata.txt row 0, the screen field is therefore blank, and :1213-1218 turns a blank AADDGRPI into LOW-VALUES - so ACUP-NEW-GROUP-ID is x'00' ten times while ACUP-OLD-GROUP-ID is ten spaces, FUNCTION TRIM strips spaces and not x'00', and the two differ. CHANGE-HAS-OCCURRED is set and the customer chain :1708-1773 is never evaluated. Two consequences are pinned by that. First, the :1463 short-circuit is UNREACHABLE for this account, so the twenty-four edits always run - which is why a case built on it can rely on them. Second, AADDGRPO in the send is x'00' ten times and NOT the ten spaces case04 shows, because 3203 :2921 moves ACUP-NEW-GROUP-ID out again unchanged; that single field is the whole difference between the two paints of the group id, and getting it wrong is the most likely way to author this case incorrectly. The case-only edit is exercised twice over: at the status comparison, where it is REACHED and found equal, and at ACSCTRY, where the operator retyped 'usa' in lower case - accepted by 1225-EDIT-ALPHA-REQD because LIT-ALL-ALPHA-FROM-X :587-591 carries both cases, repainted verbatim as 'usa' by :2938, and equal to 'USA' under the customer chain's UPPER-CASE(TRIM(...)) at :1740-1743 had that chain been reached. NONE OF THE ASSERTED VALUES DEPENDS ON WHERE 1205 EXITS: all six failures are properties of the received map and the seeded rows, so the surviving message, the state, the cursor, the highlights and the painted values are the same however the OLD copy is reconstructed. The OLD copy itself is not restated field by field - ScreenRequest.commarea admits a CDEMO- or WS- prefixed name and every item of WS-THIS-PROGCOMMAREA :653-849 is ACUP- prefixed - so it is defined by the two seeded rows, which are byte for byte what 9000-READ-ACCT :3610 onwards moved into ACUP-OLD-DETAILS in case04. THE ATTRIBUTE PLANES, and gate G38's positive half. The fifty-four xxxC colour items and fifty-four xxxH highlight items are declared; the xxxA, xxxP and xxxV items are not, for the reason case01 records - xxxA belongs to the input redefine CACTUPAI and DFHBMSCA publishes no mnemonic table for a programmed-symbol or validation byte. app/cpy/CSSETATY.cpy expands to IF (FLG-x-NOT-OK OR FLG-x-BLANK) AND CDEMO-PGM-REENTER then MOVE DFHRED TO xC, and only IF FLG-x-BLANK additionally MOVE '*' TO xO; COACTUPC instantiates it THIRTY-NINE times at :3208-:3436. THE HIGHLIGHT IS PER FIELD AND IS NOT SUBJECT TO FIRST-MESSAGE-WINS - only the message is - so SEVEN colour items carry DFHRED even though one message survived: ACSTTUSC and ACTSSN1C and ACSTFCOC and ACSPH2AC and ACSPFLGC from the five failing field edits, and ACSSTTEC and ACSZIPCC together from the single cross-field edit that SETs both flags at :2546-2547. NO field carries '*', because not one of them is BLANK - every failure is a wrong value rather than a missing one - and the context is CDEMO-PGM-REENTER, which is what makes the highlight fire at all. One CSSETATY site can never fire: :3371-3373 instantiates it for ADDRESS-LINE-2, whose edit label at :1614 is the commented-out one, so FLG-ADDRESS-LINE-2-NOT-OK and -BLANK are never set and ACSADL2C stays DFHDFCOL. Two highlights are DFHBMASB rather than DFHDFHI, both from 3390-SETUP-INFOMSG-ATTRS: INFOMSGH at :3567-3571 because WS-NO-INFO-MESSAGE is false, and FKEY12H at :3573-3576 because changes have been made and are not done. FKEY05H stays DFHDFHI: :3578-3581 needs PROMPT-FOR-CONFIRMATION and WS-INFO-MSG holds PROMPT-FOR-CHANGES. THE CURSOR IS ACSTTUSL, and it is the second-cheapest thing to get wrong after AADDGRPO. The EVALUATE at :3009-3167 is order-sensitive and walks the screen: :3010 FOUND-ACCOUNT-DATA is false because 3250 ran BEFORE 3300 - 3000-SEND-MAP :2650-2659 orders them 3100, 3200, 3250, 3300, 3390 - and overwrote the WS-INFO-MSG that :1452 had set with the change prompt; :3011 NO-CHANGES-DETECTED is false because WS-RETURN-MSG holds the Account Status text and not the 88 literal at :491-492; :3013-3014's filter arms are false because :1454 left WS-EDIT-ACCT-FLAG at the '1' of FLG-ACCTFILTER-ISVALID :184; and then :3017-3019 FLG-ACCT-STATUS-NOT-OK is TRUE and MOVEs -1 TO ACSTTUSL. Case04 reached WHEN OTHER and ACCTSIDL instead, and the difference is a single missing statement: 3202-SHOW-ORIGINAL-VALUES clears the flags with MOVE LOW-VALUES TO WS-NON-KEY-FLAGS at :2789 and 3203-SHOW-UPDATED-VALUES DOES NOT, so the error flags survive into 3300 and steal the cursor. COBOL positions the cursor by moving -1 into a symbolic-map length item, so the xxxL item IS the cursor and ACSTTUSL is named for that reason rather than as a payload field. STATELESSNESS, rule R6 and gate G37: every scrap of conversation state travels in the payload and none is held server-side. Inbound is screenRequest - EIBCALEN, the DFHENTER AID, the sixteen commarea fields and the forty-three received map fields, which is every xxxI item 1100-RECEIVE-MAP :1051-1425 actually reads, the other eleven of the fifty-four being the six header items, the two message lines and the three function-key legends. Outbound is the same sixteen fields unchanged, because nothing on this arm assigns a CDEMO- item: :1056 moves ACCTSIDI into CC-ACCT-ID, which is CVCRD01Y work storage and not the commarea, and the only writes to CDEMO-ACCT-ID on any path are :1794 in the search-key branch and 9000-READ-ACCT, neither of which runs. THE NEXT TARGET is COACTUPC / COACTUP / CACTUPA: 1000-PROCESS-INPUTS :1031-1033 moves LIT-THISPGM, LIT-THISMAPSET and LIT-THISMAP into CCARD-NEXT-PROG, -MAPSET and -MAP, and 3400-SEND-SCREEN :3591-3592 sets the last two again. Termination is RETURN_TRANSID from :1015-1018; the program's only XCTL is at :956-959 in the PF03 arm. NOTHING IS WRITTEN, and expectedWrites is empty as a POSITIVE assertion: the third arm of 2000-DECIDE-ACTION is CONTINUE, so neither the reads at :3656 and :3705 nor the read-for-update and rewrite pairs in 9600-WRITE-PROCESSING are reached, and each of the four seeded rows is pinned unchanged on the final-state channel as the other half of the same statement. The rows are the coherent slice for ACCT-ID 00000000001 that case01 and case04 use: acctdata.txt row 0, custdata.txt row 0 for CUST-ID 000000001, and carddata.txt and cardxref.txt row 48, the card and cross-reference for that account. cardxref.txt is seeded RAW at 36 bytes and is deliberately NOT pre-padded: CVACT03Y declares 50 and the fixture omits the trailing FILLER X(14), so the declared CARDXREF_FILLER_PAD_36_TO_50 normalisation supplies the fourteen spaces once, at seed time, and the final-state image is asserted at the copybook's 50 (gate G16). Pre-padding the input would double-pad it. RETURN CODE 0. COACTUPC never sets a COBOL RETURN-CODE - the identifier occurs zero times in its 4,236 lines - because it is pseudo-conversational and ends at EXEC CICS RETURN. NO ARITHMETIC IS REACHED that needs a scale: the five COMPUTE sites at :1079, :1093, :1107, :1121 and :1135 all run inside 1100-RECEIVE-MAP and each re-derives a value the screen already carried, and ROUNDED appears zero times in COACTUPC and in all twenty-eight programs, so where the program does compute, the receiver's PIC S9(10)V99 scale of 2 is reached by truncation - RoundingMode.DOWN, never HALF_UP and never HALF_EVEN. Every screen value and every record image here is US-ASCII, named explicitly and never left to the platform default (practice B8), and every width traces to a PICTURE clause rather than to a count of characters (practice B11): WS-RETURN-MSG X(75) into ERRMSGO X(78), WS-INFO-MSG X(40) into INFOMSGO X(45), the monetary X(12) commarea views against the X(15) ALPHA-VARS-FOR-DATA-EDITING work fields at :411-416, and each of the fifty-four payload items at the width its xxxI item declares in app/cpy-bms/COACTUP.CPY. The three final-state field maps name every item exactly as its copybook spells it, FILLER spans included, which is what keeps CVACT01Y's MISSPELLED ACCT-EXPIRAION-DATE and CVCUS01Y's CUST-DOB-YYYY-MM-DD unrenamed: correcting either would silently break field-for-field diffing, so neither is corrected (implicit requirement I1, practice B5). THE UNIT is reached as gate G51 requires: unitKind CONTROLLER_POJO, account.AccountUpdateController constructed directly and its handler called as a plain Java method - no MockMvc, no TestRestTemplate, no servlet container, no HTTP and no JobLauncher anywhere in the path. TWO GATES ARE NOT APPLICABLE and are recorded as such rather than silently skipped. G32 does not apply: COACTUPC's fifty-one GO TOs all target an -EXIT label, COMMON-RETURN or a forward stage, and every one this path takes is forward - :1704 out of the account chain, :1891 out of 1220-EDIT-YESNO, :2151 out of 1245-EDIT-NUM-REQD, :2311 from EDIT-AREA-CODE onward to EDIT-US-PHONE-PREFIX, :2528 out of 1275-EDIT-FICO-SCORE, :2555 out of 1280-EDIT-US-STATE-ZIP-CD and :1003 to COMMON-RETURN - so not one of them can form a loop. CBSTM03A is the only program in the migration whose GO TOs do. G35 does not apply: CALL 'CEE3ABD' occurs zero times in COACTUPC, the nine sites all being in batch programs, and its only abnormal exit is the EXEC CICS ABEND ABCODE('9999') reached from ABEND-ROUTINE, which the HANDLE ABEND at :862-864 arms but which nothing on this path can trigger. PROVENANCE, practice B12: every expected value above was derived STATICALLY, by structured reading of app/cbl/COACTUPC.cbl:463-480, :533-541, :656-668, :858-1020, :1040-1425, :1429-1676, 1205-COMPARE-OLD-NEW at :1681-1779, :1826-2560, 2000-DECIDE-ACTION at :2562-2643, :2649-2726, :2870-2983, :2986-3167, :3171-3192, :3208-3436 and :3566-3603, cross-checked against the xxxI PICTURE clauses of app/cpy-bms/COACTUP.CPY, the DFHMDF definitions and INITIAL text of app/bms/COACTUP.bms, the highlight body of app/cpy/CSSETATY.cpy, the date engine of app/cpy/CSUTLDPY.cpy and app/cpy/CSUTLDWY.cpy, the state, area-code and state-zip tables of app/cpy/CSLKPCDY.cpy, the commarea layout of app/cpy/COCOM01Y.cpy, the message texts of app/cpy/CSMSG01Y.cpy, the copybook byte layouts CVACT01Y 300 / CVCUS01Y 500 / CVACT02Y 150 / CVACT03Y 50, and the real fixtures in app/data/ASCII. It was NEVER captured from, recorded against or replayed from any execution of the legacy COBOL: executing it is empirically impossible in this environment - no z/OS or CICS runtime, the available compiler reports its indexed file handler disabled, no Language Environment CEE* services exist, and DFHAID, DFHBMSCA and DFHATTR are absent from the repository - and this static derivation is the recorded substitute for an execution baseline, escalated as risk R-A in the plan's 0.7.6 and 0.9.11 rather than silently absorbed. NO USER-SPECIFIED RULE GOVERNS THIS FILE: review_rules returns exactly one line, 'No user rules provided.' None is cited and none is invented, and the absence is not treated as licence to lower the bar - the enterprise practices are what govern instead, and they are named where they apply above: B1 no placeholder anywhere and this case's distinct target is the three ordering rules rather than any single field edit, B3 the COBOL, copybook, BMS, CSD and data trees are read strictly read-only, B5 the single surviving message, the pessimistic-first default, the invisible case-only edit, the three failures already present in the fetched data and the commented-out 'Address Line 2' label are all preserved exactly as found, B7 the clock is pinned to 2022-07-19T23:15:59 - this source revision's own timestamp, carried by every file as 'Ver: CardDemo_v1.0-15-g27d6c6f-68 Date: 2022-07-19 23:15:5x CDT' - so CURDATEO and CURTIMEO are fixed literals no wall clock can reach and every collection is ordered, B8 explicit field-to-value pairs and an explicitly named charset, B11 widths from PICTURE and xxxI clauses, B12 honest static-derivation provenance. TWO AUTHORING NOTES, recorded rather than left to be inferred. The payload items are keyed by their symbolic OUTPUT names because a sent map carries CACTUPAO, and the xxxL, xxxF and xxxA metadata items appear nowhere in this file except ACSTTUSL as the cursor, which is where COBOL expresses one. And COACTUPCParityTest currently declares its twenty scenarios in Java rather than loading them from this directory, allocating its own case14 to a SERVICE-kind check of COMPUTE ACUP-NEW-CURR-CYC-DEBIT-N at :1135-1136; the divergence in NUMBERING is recorded here, exactly as case01 records it, rather than resolved by inventing a different scenario, because the scenario itself - the three cross-cutting ordering rules driven through the controller as a plain object - is what this case is specified to pin (gates G15, G18, G30, G37, G38, G51).

OBSERVATION SCOPE, STATED SO IT CANNOT BE MISREAD AS AN OMISSION. COACTUPC contains no DISPLAY verb - no CICS program does - so this case declares no DISPLAY_LINE and no SCREEN_ERRMSG_78 message. WS-RETURN-MSG PIC X(75) at :479 leaves the program through MOVE WS-RETURN-MSG TO ERRMSGO OF CACTUPAO at :2981 followed by EXEC CICS SEND MAP, and ERRMSGO is pinned byte for byte inside expectedResponse.sends at its declared PIC X(78) width. Declaring it a second time on a message channel would make one difference report as two and would invent an emission the program does not perform. The eighty-byte WS-DATE-VALIDATION-RESULT of each CALL 'CSUTLDTC' (app/cpy/CSUTLDPY.cpy:293 into app/cpy/CSUTLDWY.cpy:60-85) IS declared, on the WS_MESSAGE_80 channel and in call order, because nothing in the response exposes it and its count is itself an assertion about how far the edit chain ran.

THE CARRIED AREA, AND WHY IT IS DECLARED IN FULL. DFHCOMMAREA carries CARDDEMO-COMMAREA and WS-THIS-PROGCOMMAREA together and :890-892 moves the second in whole, so the case declares all 873 bytes the copybook at :652-849 defines: ACUP-CHANGE-ACTION X(1), then ACUP-OLD-DETAILS and ACUP-NEW-DETAILS at 436 bytes each. The action is 'S' - 88 ACUP-SHOW-DETAILS at :659 - which is the state 3202-SHOW-ORIGINAL-VALUES leaves after a successful fetch and the only state in which 1100-RECEIVE-MAP does NOT return early at :1060-1062 and 1200-EDIT-MAP-INPUTS therefore edits all forty-three writable items. ACUP-OLD-DETAILS is the snapshot 9500-STORE-FETCHED-DATA built from the seeded ACCTDAT and CUSTDAT rows, with the three account dates and the date of birth carried at PIC X(08) rather than the record's PIC X(10) because the group drops the separators. ACUP-NEW-DETAILS is declared at LOW-VALUES throughout, which is what INITIALIZE ACUP-NEW-DETAILS at :1047 leaves before the re-staging: whatever a warm turn arrived carrying is discarded there, so declaring anything else would describe a state the program overwrites before reading.
